sn12.3:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the wrong way and the right way.
sn12.3:1.3: Listen to that and attend closely, I will speak.”
sn12.3:2.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the wrong way?
sn12.3:2.2: With ignorance as condition, volitional formations come to be;
sn12.3:2.3: with volitional formations as condition, consciousness….
sn12.3:2.4: Such is the origin of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.3:2.5: This, bhikkhus, is called the wrong way.
sn12.3:3.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the right way?
sn12.3:3.2: With the remainderless fading away and cessation of ignorance comes cessation of volitional formations; with the cessation of volitional formations,
sn12.3:3.4: Such is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.3:3.5: This, bhikkhus, is called the right way.”
